usedFor: Grist holds records in tables, and Todoist gets a task for each one through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Each new record becomes a task with a title and details, so follow-up work is not forgotten.

watchOut: “Updated Record” in Grist fires on every update, so “Create Task” can add another task for the same record.
